conclusion: The pointer-table audit closes the remaining unnamed player-collision dispatch targets in the 0x001AF21E-0x001AFFE3 family and the missing actor Type-0x0D entry, preserving shared bodies and intentional fall-through boundaries. The Type-0x5D prefix is now split from its separately callable cleanup helper at 0x001AF56C.
